sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the testing procedures P1, to be performed every three 
months
as indicated by M3 in the title block.

The purpose of the relay is basically to give an indication that over load the 
transformer or motor, this means the current flow is greater than the rated 
value cusses the load is greater than the rated load. This device operate when 
the thermal contact operate after defiant time according the vale of current 
this relay give trip signal.

The first draft of this document is initiated by eng. Baha Saleh, tested by eng. 
Kamel Tawfeek, accepted by general director eng. Abed El Azem Gomaa Hagras, and 
 approved by eng. Head Sector of Assuit Power 
 Station. and certified by eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab: UEEPC inspection & quality 
 control Head Sector and MPIS coordinator
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your Safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, safety belt.... etc
The equipment should be out of service

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: ABB test set type SVERKER 650
Clip-on ammeter type KEW SNAP 2002
Test leads.
Current test plug
Clamp ampere

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Prepare for Relay Testing

items: Review technical reference material and Manufactures manual.

Obtain copy of relay setting from field maintenance file and compare it with 
 the setting on the relay.

Look at the MRB panel nameplate and check this MRB system designation 
 nameplate agrees with the line that has been taken out of service for 
 maintenance

Perform one of the following measuring checks to verify that there is not 
 current following through this relay and the testing will occur on the correct 
 relay.

Using clip-on ammeter checks that there is not current following in the STA 
 relay circuit
Opens the STA relay over load.
Check all connections leads and wiring to the relay are in a good condition
Attach all connections between the relay and the test set.
Supply AC power to the SVERKER 650 test set.

sections.text: Testing the Function Operation of the Over Load Relay type (STA)

items: Connect the connection leads between the test set and the over load relay.
Connect the DC (b10) of the line under test.
Measure the AC injection current using clip-on ammeter type KEW. SNAP 2002.
Increase the current until the relay operates after delay time I (60).
Make reset to the relay on phase.
Check the time element of the relay.
Tripping test of the line circuit breaker performed by

Connect the CB of the line under test Adjust the current tripping value on the 
 test set.
Turn on the test set switch until the relay operates and the C.B disconnected
Make reset to the three phases of the relay.

sections.text: Return the Relay and Associated Equipment to Service

items:
Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay terminal and 
 the test set.
Make sure that the relay terminals are in normal condition.

Make sure that any equipment associated with the relay that isolated during 
 tests restored to service.
Make sure that there is no signals appeared on the signals panel

sections.text: Power Line to be returned in Service

items:
Take crossed reading of all AC currents and voltages and compare them to those 
 for normal load condition.
Place a copy of the test results in the field maintenance file.
